PF1-INIT.name: Session Start
PF1-INIT.description: Initialize session, register in DB/JSONL, spawn security teammate
tasks: PF1-TSK-01: Initialize PathFlow session record
PF1-TSK-02: Register session in DB/JSONL with tracking_level='pending'
PF1-TSK-03: Spawn cf-security teammate

PF2-CONTEXT.name: Context Awareness
PF2-CONTEXT.description: Load previous context, determine tracked vs untracked
tasks: PF2-TSK-01: Spawn cf-knowledge-layer teammate
PF2-TSK-02: Query active work and session state
PF2-TSK-03: Load memory context for current work
PF2-TSK-04: Determine tracked vs untracked decision

PF3-CLASSIFY.name: Work Classification
PF3-CLASSIFY.description: Classify work, register task, create branch, activate session
tasks: PF3-TSK-01: Classify work type and area
PF3-TSK-02: Register task in WorkGraph
PF3-TSK-03: Spawn cf-git-operations teammate
PF3-TSK-04: Create feature branch
PF3-TSK-05: Activate session: set tracking_level='tracked', populate work_type, area_type

PF4-EXECUTE.name: Work Execution
PF4-EXECUTE.description: Execute work through configured stage pipeline
tasks: PF4-TSK-01: Look up stage pipeline from work_type_stages
PF4-TSK-02: Execute primary stage (WS-DEV, WS-PLAN, WS-DOCS, or WS-TEST)
PF4-TSK-03: Execute WS-REV stage (universal review)
PF4-TSK-04: Execute WS-QA stage (if pipeline includes it)

PF5-VERIFY.name: Work Verification
PF5-VERIFY.description: Verify all stages passed and acceptance criteria met
tasks: PF5-TSK-01: Verify all pipeline stages completed with pass verdict
PF5-TSK-02: Check acceptance criteria met

PF6-COMPLETE.name: Work Completion
tasks: PF6-TSK-01: Update task status to complete in WorkGraph
PF6-TSK-02: Create PR via cf-git-operations

PF7-END.name: Session End
tasks: PF7-TSK-01: Shutdown on-demand role teammates
PF7-TSK-02: Shutdown persistent function teammates
PF7-TSK-03: Write session summary to JSONL
PF7-TSK-04: Clean up session state and temp files
PF7-TSK-05: TeamDelete (dissolve team infrastructure; SessionEnd hook handles flag and state cleanup)

mirroring.description: Task tracker entries are visual mirrors of PathFlow state. JSONL/SQLite is authoritative. Task tracker is derived and disposable.

PF1-INIT.subject: PF1-INIT: Initialize session
PF1-INIT.description: Register session record, spawn cf-security. Phase: {phase_id}, Session: {session_id}.

PF2-CONTEXT.subject: PF2-CONTEXT: Load context
PF2-CONTEXT.description: Spawn cf-knowledge-layer, query active work, load memory. Phase: {phase_id}, Session: {session_id}.

PF3-CLASSIFY.subject: PF3-CLASSIFY: Classify and register work
PF3-CLASSIFY.description: Classify work type, register task in WorkGraph, create branch. Phase: {phase_id}, Task: {task_id}, Session: {session_id}.

PF4-EXECUTE.subject: PF4-EXECUTE: Run work pipeline
PF4-EXECUTE.description: Execute stage pipeline for {work_type}: {pipeline}. Phase: {phase_id}, Task: {task_id}, Session: {session_id}.

PF5-VERIFY.subject: PF5-VERIFY: Verify acceptance criteria
PF5-VERIFY.description: Verify all pipeline stages passed and acceptance criteria met. Phase: {phase_id}, Task: {task_id}, Session: {session_id}.

PF6-COMPLETE.subject: PF6-COMPLETE: Create PR and finalize
PF6-COMPLETE.description: Create PR via cf-git-operations, mark task complete. Phase: {phase_id}, Task: {task_id}, Session: {session_id}.

PF7-END.subject: PF7-END: End session
PF7-END.description: Shutdown teammates, write session summary, cleanup. Phase: {phase_id}, Session: {session_id}.

WS-DEV.subject: WS-DEV: Development ({task_id})
WS-DEV.description: Code implementation and unit tests. Stage: {stage_id}, Teammate: cf-development, Task: {task_id}, Iteration: {iteration}.

WS-PLAN.subject: WS-PLAN: Planning ({task_id})
WS-PLAN.description: Design, architecture, and analysis. Stage: {stage_id}, Teammate: cf-planning, Task: {task_id}, Iteration: {iteration}.

WS-DOCS.subject: WS-DOCS: Documentation ({task_id})
WS-DOCS.description: Documentation writing and updates. Stage: {stage_id}, Teammate: cf-documentation, Task: {task_id}, Iteration: {iteration}.

WS-TEST.subject: WS-TEST: Testing ({task_id})
WS-TEST.description: Test implementation as primary deliverable. Stage: {stage_id}, Teammate: cf-quality-assurance, Task: {task_id}, Iteration: {iteration}.

WS-REV.subject: WS-REV: Review ({task_id})
WS-REV.description: Independent review of completed work. Stage: {stage_id}, Teammate: cf-review, Mode: {review_mode}, Task: {task_id}, Iteration: {iteration}.

WS-QA.subject: WS-QA: Quality Assurance ({task_id})
WS-QA.description: Integration testing and acceptance verification. Stage: {stage_id}, Teammate: cf-quality-assurance, Task: {task_id}, Retry: {retry}.
